A group of friends, including one who's lesbian and another who's pansexual, were talking about commitment and living together. The lesbian one said they wouldn't move in with someone until they were married, while the pansexual one said they would be happy to move in with someone shortly after beginning a relationship. Which person would want to wait to live with a romantic partner?
A. The lesbian one
B. The pansexual one
C. Not enough info
